Registration is open for EntMoot 3026, the premier gathering on slow institutions.

**Practical information:**

- The opening plenary — establishing that everyone present is, in fact, present — takes four days.
- The keynote, *"Deliberative Democracy at Geological Timescales,"* runs approximately three weeks. Attendees are advised to arrange sabbaticals rather than leave.
- Coffee breaks are not offered. Water is available in unlimited quantities if you stand in the river.
- A "hasty track" for mortal attendees compresses the full programme into a single month.

Don't be hasty. Register when you feel ready. There is no deadline, on principle.
